design_brief_zh: 主卖点是360°双排万向轮（8轮），以“轮组结构特写+机场或城市移动场景”证明转向功能和使用收益。PC端使用2000×2000画布，左侧文案区[x=0.05,y=0.10,w=0.38,h=0.80]，右侧产品区[x=0.49,y=0.08,w=0.46,h=0.84]；阅读顺序为标题、支持说明、铝合金拉杆与三挡调节、PC+ABS箱壳细节。右侧以45度前侧视角展示真实箱体，确保八个双排轮完整可见；在底部轮组旁加入局部放大视图或细线指向，清晰展示双排结构和360°转向。箱壳局部展示竖纹、PC+ABS材质外观及四个防撞角，但不加入防刮文字或磨损对比。移动端使用1200×1200画布，上方场景和产品位于[x=0.08,y=0.05,w=0.84,h=0.53]，轮组特写保持在上方视觉中心；下方文案区位于[x=0.05,y=0.64,w=0.90,h=0.31]。四行文案按标题、八轮转向及机场城市移动收益、铝合金拉杆和三挡调节、PC+ABS箱壳与结构细节排列；德语预留约20%横向扩展空间。采用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色、自然侧光和柔和接触阴影，控制金属反光，保持产品真实颜色与纹理。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题最大，支持说明次之，细节行使用清晰短行和数字优先。资料未提供量化耐刮测试或防刮证明，因此仅展示箱壳纹理和四个防撞角，不写耐刮、耐磨、静音或适用于所有地面的结论。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的360°双排八轮、铝合金拉杆、三挡调节、PC+ABS箱壳、竖纹和四个防撞角事实；机场与城市移动仅作使用场景，不扩展为所有地面适用。资料未提供防刮或耐磨测试，因此不得宣称防刮、耐磨、静音或经过认证；不得添加竞品标识、虚构测试、评分、官方背书、额外保证或促销信息。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European-modern travel photography visual for a YWJ 13A travel suitcase. Follow a split composition: on desktop, place the real suitcase on the right in a 45-degree front-side view within the right product area, and leave a clean quiet text area on the left; on mobile, place the suitcase and an airport or urban sidewalk scene in the upper portion, with a clean text area below. Make the eight double swivel wheels clearly visible and add a realistic close-up inset or fine-line visual pointer beside the wheel assembly to show the paired-wheel structure and 360-degree swivel movement. Show the aluminium telescopic handle extended with its three height positions suggested through a subtle visual sequence, without labels. Include a close shell detail showing the PC+ABS exterior, vertical texture, and all four protective corners. Use low-saturation neutral tones, natural side lighting, soft contact shadows, controlled highlights, and accurate product colors. Use realistic proportions and materials; do not add logos from other brands, extra accessories, badges, claims, diagrams implying testing, or unsupported durability effects. Reserve the specified copy regions with strong contrast and generous spacing. Do not render any text, letters, numbers, labels, icons, or typography in the image.
